Primary repo kodifitzwell.github.io is EMPTY; kodiyashimaru mirror is the live source (magneto is POV's built-in scraper, version-sibling 6.07.x). Overlay = kodirdil Hebrew subs + genres/ratings patches + curated network logos. Kodi-version-agnostic: one build, both fleets.
changelog: 0.1.9: banner waits for the home window before toasting (a notification fired before the skin is ready is silently dropped -- boot race), and every skip/failure now logs a kodirdil banner line instead of a blind except-pass. 0.1.8: banner text made bidi-safe (Hebrew-leading, single Latin run at the end) -- the mixed-run line rendered scrambled on RTL. 0.1.7: debrid subscription banner FIXED -- it never showed because the field paths were ported verbatim from Gears, but POV unwraps the data envelope in _request (TorBox+AllDebrid): data.premium_expires_at -> premium_expires_at, data.user.premiumUntil -> user.premiumUntil; the dig returned None and the silent except hid it. 0.1.6: the clear-on-open of subs.player_filename now fires only when NOTHING is playing -- browsing the source list mid-playback and backing out was wiping the ACTIVE release, flipping every subtitle match percentage to tagline-similarity (44/40/38 -> 25/25/23). 0.1.5: publish the chosen source's release name on Window(10000) as subs.player_filename (cleared when the source list opens). Gears has always set this in modules/player.py; POV never did, and for debrid streams the player's own file is a bare UUID (997ec702-0c77-...), so subtitle services had NO channel to learn which release is playing. GearsAI fell back to VideoPlayer.Tagline -- the movie's marketing tagline -- so match.player_release() returned empty and the community pool took its 'no release detected' path, which is how an out-of-sync Hebrew subtitle got served for Supergirl. Set at all four play-selection points (direct, manual magnet/nzb, seekable easynews, browse packs). 0.1.4: filter menu -- ALL kodirdil filters now sort to the TOP as one bulleted group (SDR was appended last), and the [COLOR] markup was dropped: select_dialog renders rows with line1.upper(), which uppercases the tag itself ([COLOR cyan] -> [COLOR CYAN]); Kodi cannot resolve that colour, so a label wrapped entirely in the tag rendered as an EMPTY row -- the blank "מיין לפי כתוביות עבריות" entry. 0.1.3: filter_results -- the kodirdil Hebrew-subs/SDR filter choices were handled AFTER the quality/provider fall-through, which built its options from a nonexistent tikiskins.<choice> property -> empty second dialog (0/0) and no filtering. The custom choices are now single-action branches handled first. 0.1.2: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.89. Upstream renamed the source-result field URLName -> display_name (produced in modules/sources.py, consumed in windows/sources.py) and added a hidden database.merge_status setting. Textual 3-way merge was clean, but our kodirdil READS of that field (tried-source identifier in _add/_is_tried_source, and the Hebrew per-source tagline matcher) still pointed at URLName -> re-pointed to display_name so Hebrew matching keeps working. Verified: 0 URLName left, 0 upstream lines lost, valid AST, all KODIRDIL markers (3+9) + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings preserved. 0.1.1: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.08. Upstream refactored modules/sources.py results/thread machinery (wait() -> thread_monitor()+progress_update(), removed random.shuffle, as_completed flow); our kodirdil Hebrew-subs thread + GearsAI prefetch trigger (top of get_sources) re-applied by 3-way merge, verified leak-free (0 upstream lines lost, valid AST). 0.1.0: initial Hebrew overlay re-derived fresh from the current Gears overlay (kodirdil) onto clean POV 6.07.07.
